lines.lyric: Eoduun bami modul jaeul ttae modu jame deul ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 어두운 밤이 모둘 재울 때 모두 잠에 들 때
lines.lyric_translation: When the dark night puts everyone to sleep, when everyone’s asleep
I can’t sleep because of my countless thoughts
Hoping that I’ll think of something

lines.lyric: Achim haega modul kkaeul ttaekkaji wait
lines.lyric_hangul: 아침 해가 모둘 깨울 때까지 wait
lines.lyric_translation: I wait till the morning sun wakes everyone up

lines.lyric: Modu bang bureul kkeul ttae allameul matchul ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 모두 방 불을 끌 때 알람을 맞출 때
lines.lyric_translation: When everyone turns the light off, when they’re setting their alarm
When I’m tired, my worries open its eyes
Looking back at my day to see if it was good

lines.lyric: Naeireun mweol haji mweoji allam sori ttaeng
lines.lyric_hangul: 내일은 뭘 하지 뭐지 알람 소리 땡
lines.lyric_translation: Wondering what I’m gonna do tomorrow, then the alarm goes off
It’s complicated but don’t worry about it
Once you wake up, it’ll all go away
They chase after me even in my dreams
But it’ll all be forgotten
I try to forget but it comes back again
I don’t wanna be caught up in this anymore
I try rolling up the blankets, I try screaming
But in the end, I get up again
I can’t sleep / I can’t sleep
So tell me
Tonight, I’m awake again
It’ll probably be like this tomorrow night too

lines.lyric: So tell me now, I’ll find a way
lines.lyric_hangul: So tell me now, I'll find a way
lines.lyric_translation: So tell me now, I’ll find a way

lines.lyric: Naeil bamdo nan there is no other way
lines.lyric_hangul: 내일 밤도 난 there is no other way
lines.lyric_translation: Tomorrow night, there is no other way
I can’t sleep
No way, all go away
At school, I get so sleepy, what can I do?

lines.lyric: Go away da joyonghae jamina jallae shwit
lines.lyric_hangul: Go away 다 조용해 잠이나 잘래 쉿
lines.lyric_translation: Go away, be quiet, I wanna sleep

lines.lyric: I just want you to know
lines.lyric_hangul: I just want you to know
lines.lyric_translation: I just want you to know
I can’t take it anymore

lines.lyric: Jaya hal ttaen jame deul su eopseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 자야 할 땐 잠에 들 수 없어
lines.lyric_translation: I can’t sleep when I should sleep
So tell me now
It’s complicated but don’t worry about it
Once you wake up, it’ll all go away
They chase after me even in my dreams
But it’ll all be forgotten
I try to forget but it comes back again
I don’t wanna be caught up in this anymore
I try rolling up the blankets, I try screaming
But in the end, I get up again
I can’t sleep
So tell me
Tonight, I’m awake again
It’ll probably be like this tomorrow night too

lines.lyric: So tell me now, I’ll find a way
lines.lyric_hangul: So tell me now, I'll find a way
lines.lyric_translation: So tell me now, I’ll find a way

lines.lyric: Naeil bamdo nan there is no other way
lines.lyric_hangul: 내일 밤도 난 there is no other way
lines.lyric_translation: Tomorrow night, there is no other way
I can’t sleep

lines.lyric: Achime nuneul tteo jameseo kkaesseul ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 아침에 눈을 떠 잠에서 깼을 때
lines.lyric_translation: When I open my eyes and get up
I wish I felt more rested

lines.lyric: Joatteon kkumeul kkweotteon bamimyeon hae eonjenga
lines.lyric_hangul: 좋았던 꿈을 꿨던 밤이면 해 언젠가
lines.lyric_translation: I wish I can have a night with good dreams
Like the sun that goes to sleep at night
I want to peacefully fall asleep
For a tomorrow that will shine brighter
I can’t sleep
So tell me
So just tell me
Tonight, I’m awake again
It’ll probably be like this tomorrow night too

lines.lyric: So tell me now, I’ll find a way
lines.lyric_hangul: So tell me now, I'll find a way
lines.lyric_translation: So tell me now, I’ll find a way
